Exercise - Argument order
```{r}
#Arguments in order
print(rep(5, 7))

#Names
print(rep(x = 5, times = 7))
```

Exercise - Character, numerical and logical variables
```{r}
#Character
a <- "Jacqueline"

#Numeric
b <- 7

#Logical
c <- TRUE

print(class(a))
print(class(b))
print(class(c))
```
